text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr takes the win! Yamanin
Zephyr
pushes past a lineup of
formidable foes to
conquer the Yasuda
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But I can't dance atop this
auspicious
updraft forever.
choice_data_list: お帰り。それからおめでとう、ゼファー！

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin preparations for the next
stage—the
race to decide the fastest
gust of all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We shall blow as a razor-sharp
flurry.
choice_data_list: ああ。次は『スプリンターズS』制覇だ！
うん。次は『スプリンターズS』制覇だね！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. Next up is conquering the Sprinters Stakes!
Yeah. Next up is winning the Sprinters Stakes!
